# A payment of INV-USD-001 giving the split on the CAD receivable.
#
# INV-USD-001 posts to `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD`. The split this block
# gives, from money_booked_to_another_receivable.txt, is on
# `Assets:Accounts Receivable CAD`, so taking it would put a settlement of this
# invoice in a lot on a receivable the invoice does not post to.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "d0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f"
    txn_split_guid: "f2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1"
